newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-UNITED LINKED WITH ITALIAN STRIKER MONTELLA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-UNITED LINKED WITH ITALIAN STRIKER MONTELLA.

text.p: English champions Manchester United are interested in signing Sampdoria's 23-year-old striker Vincenzo Montella, the second highest scorer in the Italian first division last season.
United's telephone Clubcall for fans said on Sunday that manager Alex Ferguson had been keeping a close eye on the Italian forward who hit 22 goals in Serie A last season.
Montella, who was 23 last month, started with third division Empoli, playing one match in the 1990-91 season.
After establishing himself there he scored 21 goals in one second division season with Genoa before joining neighbours Sampdoria last summer.

United manager Alex Ferguson's last major signing was England international striker Teddy Sheringham who moved from Tottenham for 3.5 million pounds ($6 million) last month as a replacement for the retired Eric Cantona.
